description: This file defines a Java interface named LogNode, which specifies a contract for log handlers in a logging chain. It includes a method println to output log data with various parameters such as priority, tag, message, and an optional Throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a node in a logging chain, capable of outputting log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception information.
